notes: Full real-space sign-invariant CAD on identical polynomials and variable order; no SAT pruning.
Original sources are exactly git archive 9ffc20ea9958bfaca3c9e789699b3ae0f5cf0709; only the timing/progress driver is new.

Original uses explicit plain Lazard. The historical poly.cad facade could automatically choose reduced McCallum; that automatic selection was not measured. Saved private run uses Revision 15 projection and interval field-relative construction. This compares complete implementations, not an isolated projection-policy change.

Identical Mojo/APN, -O3 and one pinned runtime CPU. The old run was stopped at the user-requested 1800 seconds; the saved private run has a 7200-second cap. These caps are not matched. No concurrent task compiler or benchmark work; host contention is uncontrolled.
The saved private timeout predates M6. It did not finish construction and has no accepted result.

The original 7200-second timer was superseded while running by the user's 1800-second stop request. Process timed_out is false because the user-limit controller sent SIGTERM; this is not an algorithmic error or accepted result.
The original CAD exceeded 30 minutes before construction completed. Its two-hour outcome is unknown, so these censored runs do not establish relative speed or exclude a regression.
conclusion: The user stopped original CAD at 30 minutes without construction completing. Original CAD also exceeds the earlier 15-minute limit and the new 30-minute limit; its outcome under the saved private run's 7200-second cap remains untested. Relative completion speed and any regression remain unresolved.
